title: Unified dot vocabulary
description: ABORDANDO and PRÓXIMO gain small leading dots, matching SALIENDO's existing pulsing dot vocabulary: ABORDANDO gets a solid amber dot (state is live/current), PRÓXIMO gets an amber outline dot (state is upcoming, not yet current). Requires a small markup addition (a leading dot span inside .arrival-row__state) but no new color.
baseline_ref: .arrival-row__departing already has a leading amber dot (.arrival-row__departing-dot); .arrival-row__state currently has no leading dot for ABORDANDO or PRÓXIMO

changes.intent: Add a leading dot span inside the state label so ABORDANDO and PRÓXIMO can carry the same dot vocabulary SALIENDO already uses.
changes.detail: Wrap state text with a new inner span, e.g. ABORDANDO, conditionally styled solid vs outline depending on whether the row is --now or --soon.

changes.intent: ABORDANDO's dot is solid amber — a live/current state, matching the filled style of SALIENDO's dot.
PRÓXIMO's dot is an amber outline — upcoming but not yet current, visually lighter than ABORDANDO's solid dot.
